not_configured.description:
The {device_name} ({serial_number}) has not been set up in the Airthings app yet. Until it is, the device only turns on Bluetooth for a short time after its button is pressed, so the Airthings BLE integration cannot read its measurements regularly.

To fix this:
1. Open the Airthings app.
2. Add your {device_name} and select Bluetooth as its connectivity.

This issue is resolved automatically the next time Home Assistant reads data from the device over Bluetooth, which it tries every {update_interval} minutes.
not_configured.title: {device_name} connectivity is not set up

smartlink.description:
The {device_name} ({serial_number}) is using SmartLink (hub) connectivity, which is not supported by the Airthings BLE integration. In this mode, the device only turns on Bluetooth for a short time after its button is pressed, so the integration cannot read its measurements regularly.

If you want to keep using SmartLink:
1. Set up the Airthings integration and sign in to your Airthings account.
2. Delete this device from the Airthings BLE integration.

If you want to use Bluetooth instead:
1. Open the Airthings app.
2. Go to Settings > Devices.
3. Select your {device_name}.
4. Select 'Reset connectivity' to switch to Bluetooth.

This issue is resolved automatically the next time Home Assistant reads data from the device over Bluetooth, which it tries every {update_interval} minutes.
smartlink.title: {device_name} uses SmartLink connectivity
